claims.athlete_disjoint_diagnostic: A separate pre-freeze player-group diagnostic measures generalization to unseen identities. It is non-temporal and does not replace or change the frozen-season evidence gate.
claims.bridge: exploratory analogy; not a sport-switch probability or validated outcome forecast
claims.bridge_target_proxy_reconstruction_gate: Compatibility name for a forward target-role test: prior build plus shared canonical dimensions must improve on build alone; it is not cross-sport validation.
claims.native_profile: next-season benchmark using only build and canonical cross-sport dimensions; promotion requires incremental evidence over build alone
claims.partial_pooling: Native build-plus-profile heads may borrow from predeclared related-role families. Shrinkage is tuned only in pre-2025 rolling folds and deployed only when the frozen athlete-clustered 90% MAE-advantage interval over role-only has a positive lower bound with at least 20 eligible athletes.
claims.percentile_validation: Frozen predictions receive fixed-bin percentile calibration and threshold plus cohort-ranked top-decile diagnostics; these are reported, not used to tune gates.
claims.physical: performance association from build; not causal
claims.prediction_uncertainty: Nominal 90% prediction ranges use rolling-origin absolute residuals with one latest residual per athlete and a finite-sample conformal order statistic. Frozen empirical coverage is reported and cross-sport distribution shift can invalidate nominal coverage.
claims.team_context: Completed-season role opportunity share and leave-one-player-out teammate strength are tested only as next-season native-forecast candidates. The base role/history model remains deployed unless the candidate beats the base model, the best history baseline, and neutral on the frozen cohort with at least 20 eligible athletes having both context fields. Team identity and future-season context are never model inputs, and context never enters cross-sport bridges.
claims.training_cohort: Eligible and positive-opportunity low-sample labels may train with empirical opportunity/coverage weights. Frozen evaluation remains eligible-only, and rows must satisfy the deployed build and fixed-dimension requirements.

rights_and_scope.epl: Broad-role local research prototype; do not redistribute cached FPL/community raw data without rights review.
rights_and_scope.nba: SportsDataverse research snapshot; preserve upstream attribution and review redistribution rights.
rights_and_scope.nfl: Core nflverse data; optional PFR/community enrichment remains conditional.
rights_and_scope.nhl: MoneyPuck designated downloads; non-commercial use with clear attribution.

validation_methods.athlete_disjoint_diagnostic: A separate pre-2025 group-fold diagnostic keeps every season for an athlete in one fold. It measures identity generalization and does not replace the future-season gate.
validation_methods.chronological_gate: The saved evidence gates remain based on the frozen 2025 chronological test and their declared baseline comparisons.
validation_methods.percentile_calibration: Frozen predictions are compared with observed 0-100 percentiles in fixed 10-point bins and with both threshold and rank-based top-decile checks.
validation_methods.prediction_range: The nominal 90% range uses the finite-sample absolute-residual order statistic from rolling-origin predictions, retaining one latest residual per athlete. Frozen coverage is reported rather than assumed.

known_limitations: This is a separate possession/disruption study, not the broad all-role bridge shown above.
No saved head has a 95% bootstrap improvement interval wholly above zero.
The EPL defender target has a known partial-block completeness issue and remains under review.
A cross-sport software component exists, but useful transfer learning has not been established.
